title: Degree of an affine map coordinate
statement: Let $L$ be an affine map from the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$ to itself, and let $i$ be a coordinate index. The Boolean function that sends $x$ to the $i$th coordinate of $L(x)$ has algebraic degree at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is an affine map from the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$ to itself
